Exercise: Two-Arm Kettlebell Military Press

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- shoulder_press

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- triceps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
aerobic and anaerobic

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- muscular_endurance
- strength

Contraindications:

- Shoulder impingement or rotator cuff issues

Exercise Variations:

- name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Front Raise to Press, equipment: kettlebells
- name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Overhead Press, equipment: kettlebells

Substitution Options:

- name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Military Press, equipment: dumbbells
- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Military Press, equipment: kettlebells, primaryMuscles: ['shoulders', 'triceps'], secondaryMuscles: []

Instructions:

- Clean two kettlebells to your shoulders. Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you swing the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so, so that the palms face forward.
- Press the kettlebells up and out. As the kettlebells pass your head, lean into the weights so that the kettlebells are racked behind your head. Make sure to contract your lats, butt, and stomach for added stability.
